title: The Flow
use_cases: Use when automating the collection and semantic tagging of research papers
Implement when long-term persistence of context across multiple Claude sessions is required
Configure when local vector indexing is needed for offline document retrieval
Use when performing semantic queries against a custom research database
Configure when organizing technical knowledge into hierarchical area codes for instant retrieval
content:
**During a research session:**

```
You: "Claude, research quantum de Sitter space and landscape dynamics"

Claude: → Uses mcp__firecrawl_mcp__firecrawl_scrape("https://arxiv.org/abs/hep-th/0609062")
        → Uses mcp__llm_kg__kg_add(content, url, title)

        For each document:
        ✓ Analyzed by Claude → extracts learnings, insights, questions
        ✓ Embedded locally → 384-dim semantic vectors via sentence-transformers
        ✓ Assigned semantic area code → physics.cosmology.desitter
        ✓ Stored persistently → DuckDB + vector index

        "✅ Added 'Towards a quantum theory of de Sitter space' (Banks, Fiol, Morisse)
            to physics.cosmology.desitter"
        "✅ Added 'Metastable Domains of the Landscape' (arXiv:0712.1397)
            to physics.strings.landscape"

You: "What did we learn about de Sitter holography?"

Claude: → Uses mcp__llm_kg__kg_query("de Sitter holography quantum", top_k=5)

        Returns 5 semantically similar documents with:
        • Full summaries of what each paper teaches
        • Key learnings and insights extracted
        • Questions raised by the content
        • Similarity scores (cosine distance)

        "The papers explore how particle states and Schwarzschild de Sitter black holes
         arise as excitations in a theory of fermionic oscillators... [shows 5 relevant
         papers including KKLT (hep-th/0301240), amplituhedron work, and related research]"

You: "Show me all papers in the de Sitter area"

Claude: → Uses mcp__llm_kg__kg_get_document("physics.cosmology.desitter")
        → Returns ALL documents with that area_code
        → Instant retrieval, zero API calls, fully local

        "Found 3 documents in physics.cosmology.desitter:
         1. Towards a quantum theory of de Sitter space (Banks, Fiol, Morisse)
         2. Holographic description of dS space (follow-up paper)
         3. de Sitter entropy bounds..."
```

**Next session (days/weeks later):**

```
You: "Remember those de Sitter landscape papers we studied?"

Claude: → Uses mcp__llm_kg__kg_query("de Sitter landscape metastable vacua")

        "Yes! We studied quantum de Sitter space (Banks/Fiol/Morisse) and metastable
         domains of the landscape (Dine et al.)... [retrieves all relevant documents
         with full context including connections to KKLT and the string landscape]"

        → Knowledge graph persists across ALL sessions
        → Semantic relationships preserved forever
        → Claude's memory is permanent and searchable
```
